description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of the MADLLM model and its variants across six different datasets—SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI—under four experimental conditions: MADLLM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with major tick marks at 10-point intervals. The horizontal axis lists the datasets, with the bars for each dataset grouped together and sorted from left to right in descending order of the MADLLM model's performance. For each dataset, the four bars are colored green (MADLLM), purple (MADLLM w/o feature embedding), blue (MADLLM w/o prompt pool), and brown (MADLLM w/o skip embedding). In general, the MADLLM model achieves the highest F1 scores across all datasets, with the most significant performance drop observed when removing the feature embedding (purple bars), which consistently results in lower scores compared to the full model. The highest F1 score is achieved by MADLLM on the PSM dataset, reaching approximately 97%, while the lowest score is observed for MADLLM w/o skip embedding on the WADI dataset, at approximately 68%. The chart clearly shows that the full MADLLM model outperforms all its variants, and the impact of removing specific components varies by dataset, with the feature embedding appearing to have the most substantial effect on performance.
